metadata.title: Back to the Night My Sister Stole My Fiancé
metadata.subtitle: She spiked my tea at the engagement gala and leaked staged photos to ruin my family name. I woke up holding the untouched cup—and swapped it with hers.

nodes.text: 8:10 PM · Jasmine steam curls from the porcelain cup in your hand. Last life, three sips put you to sleep in Suite 904 while paparazzi broke down the door.
Drink up, sis! You’ve been greeting guests all night—I brewed your favorite jasmine blend myself.
So thoughtful, Valerie. Why don’t we trade cups? Yours looks hotter.
Caleb, keep the hired photographer waiting outside Suite 904 at 8:45 PM.

nodes.transcript: [smooth low voice] "Excuse me, Miss Madeline—I saw your sister drop a clear capsule into that jasmine cup two minutes ago."

nodes.prompt: Valerie hesitates when you offer to swap teacups:

options.label: Swap cups smoothly while she glances at Caleb
options.player_reply_text: Oops, I already grabbed yours! Cheers to my engagement night, Valerie.

options.label: Pour half into a crystal napkin for lab testing

nodes.text: Valerie gulps down her own spiked cup to avoid looking suspicious—her eyelids drooping within minutes.
Wait—why is the chandelier spinning?! Caleb, help me to a chair!!
You save half the drugged tea in a perfume atomizer AND hand Nathaniel a copy of the lab receipt.
Why aren’t you drinking, Madeline?! Don’t waste my tea!!
Caleb rushes over and lifts a dizzy Valerie into his arms—heading straight toward the elevator for Suite 904.
Nathaniel Brooks, by the way. Would you like to watch them walk into their own paparazzi ambush?

nodes.headline: Taste Of Her Own Tea
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The 8:45 PM Ambush — In your first life, Caleb led your parents and six bloggers to Suite 904 at 8:45 PM to "catch" you with a stranger..

nodes.text: 8:35 PM · In your first life, Caleb led your parents and six bloggers to Suite 904 at 8:45 PM to "catch" you with a stranger.
Madeline, where are you? Your sister felt faint so I took her upstairs to rest—don’t come up, I’ll handle it.
How sweet. Your hired bloggers just texted asking if 904 is unlocked yet.
Wait—why is Valerie asleep in 904 instead of Madeline?! Cancel the bloggers NOW!!

nodes.transcript: [amused chuckle] "Too late—I just sent the hotel concierge to escort your parents AND the bloggers straight to Suite 904."

nodes.prompt: You stand outside Suite 904 as camera flashes ready in the hall:

options.label: Knock loudly & swing the unlatched door wide
options.player_reply_text: Caleb? Valerie? Everyone’s worried—oh my god, what are you two doing?!

options.label: Wait for your father to open the door himself

nodes.text: Six camera shutters explode as Caleb scrambles off the bed next to a half-dressed Valerie.
Turn off the cameras!! This is a misunderstanding—she fainted!!
Your father pushes the door open himself—freezing in pure rage at the sight of his future son-in-law.
Sir, wait—Valerie tricked me!! Ask Madeline!!
The engagement scandal meant to bury you just incinerated Caleb and Valerie in front of the entire city.
No!! That room was supposed to be for Madeline—the keycard is even under her name!!

nodes.headline: Slip Of The Tongue
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Keycard 904 — Valerie just blurted out the one thing she shouldn’t have—and Nathaniel already pulled the front-desk billing log..

nodes.text: 8:55 PM · Valerie just blurted out the one thing she shouldn’t have—and Nathaniel already pulled the front-desk billing log.
Here’s the Suite 904 keycard and front-desk log. Paid with Caleb Vance’s Amex at 6:15 PM—two hours before the gala.
Let’s show my father who really booked the trap room tonight.
Valerie, shut your mouth!! You’re confessing to drugging your own sister!!

nodes.transcript: [cool precision] "Better yet—the hotel sommelier already handed the police your spiked jasmine tea sample."

nodes.caption: Suite 904 plastic keycard — booked at 6:15 PM using Caleb Vance’s credit card for the staged photo trap.

nodes.prompt: Your father demands to know if the wedding is still happening:

options.label: Drop the engagement ring into Caleb’s champagne
options.player_reply_text: The engagement is dead, Dad. And I’m pressing charges for the drugged tea.

options.label: Partner with Nathaniel Brooks right onstage

nodes.text: Your diamond ring plinks to the bottom of Caleb’s flute. Guests burst into shocked applause.
Madeline, don’t throw away our two families’ merger over one mistake!!
Nathaniel steps beside you smoothly—offering double Caleb’s investment terms for your father’s textile brand.
Brooks Capital?! Madeline, when did you even meet him?!
Caleb’s father storms out of the ballroom, furious that his son just lost both the bride and the merger.
Wait—if you call the police, you’ll ruin our family’s reputation too, Madeline!

nodes.headline: Reputation Over Blood
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Stolen Designs — Next morning.

nodes.text: 10:30 AM · Next morning. You remember Valerie’s second betrayal from your first life: selling your autumn couture sketches to Caleb’s rival atelier.
Madeline, my IP team just spotted Valerie leaving Luxe Atelier with a leather portfolio tube.
Too bad I replaced my real portfolio with last season’s rejected drafts at midnight.
Caleb, Luxe Atelier paid $150K cash for her autumn line! Now we can pay off your dad’s fine!

nodes.transcript: [laughing softly] "Luxe Atelier’s director just unrolled the tube—and found your watermarked ‘STOLEN PROPERTY’ stamp on every sketch!"

nodes.prompt: Luxe Atelier’s furious director is demanding Valerie’s arrest for selling fake goods:

options.label: Text Valerie the copyright registry receipt
options.player_reply_text: Enjoy explaining to Luxe Atelier why you sold them rejected sketches, Valerie.

options.label: Send Nathaniel’s IP lawyers to buy Luxe’s debt

nodes.text: Valerie calls you sobbing from the Luxe Atelier lobby while security holds her purse.
You tricked me!! They won’t let me leave until I pay back $150K!!
Nathaniel’s team acquires Luxe Atelier’s trade-secret claim—making YOU Valerie’s sole legal creditor.
You own my debt now?! Please sis, I’m begging you!!
Your real autumn couture line launches online at noon—selling out in eleven minutes flat.
Stop torturing Valerie, Madeline! Come talk to me alone at the greenhouse tonight!

nodes.headline: The Greenhouse Trap
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Broken Greenhouse — Caleb is desperate—his father cut off his allowance.

nodes.text: 8:20 PM · Caleb is desperate—his father cut off his allowance. He plans to force a fake "reconciliation" photo in the rain-soaked family greenhouse.
I’m waiting in the orchid house. If you don’t come, I’ll tell the tabloids you framed Valerie yourself!
I’ll be there in five minutes. Don’t bother hiding your photographer in the ferns.
Make sure you snap the angle where it looks like she’s hugging me back!

nodes.transcript: [calm steady voice] "Don’t worry—I already walked around the back and offered his photographer triple to shoot the real truth."

nodes.prompt: Caleb steps out from the orchids and grabs your wrist roughly:

options.label: Shove him back into the koi fountain
options.player_reply_text: Touch me again and your assault charge gets upgraded, Caleb!

options.label: Let Nathaniel step out of the shadows behind him

nodes.text: Caleb loses his footing on the wet tiles and splashes straight into three feet of cold koi pond.
My $3,000 suit!! And why is the photographer filming ME?!
Nathaniel’s tall frame blocks the greenhouse door, his cold gaze pinning Caleb against the glass.
Brooks?! Stay out of my personal business!!
The photographer emails you the uncut 4K clip of Caleb threatening you—ending his tabloid bluff forever.
Your father’s board just voted to sever all Vance ties permanently. Caleb’s family is out.

nodes.headline: Severed Forever
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Secret Debt — Why did Valerie spike your tea so recklessly? You finally remember: she owed $400K to an underground gambling ring..

nodes.text: 1:10 PM · Why did Valerie spike your tea so recklessly? You finally remember: she owed $400K to an underground gambling ring.
Madeline, please! Those men are outside my apartment right now—they said if I don’t pay by 5 PM they’ll take my car!
You tried to ruin my life to pay off your gambling tabs, Valerie.
Caleb blocked my number! Nobody else will pick up!

nodes.transcript: [cool voice] "My security checked the men outside her building—they’re actually unlicensed loan sharks. Police already have an open file on them."

nodes.prompt: Valerie begs you to wire $400K immediately:

options.label: Refuse cash & call police on the loan sharks
options.player_reply_text: I won’t enable your gambling, Valerie—but police are on the way to clear your lobby.

options.label: Make her sign a full confession to Dad first

nodes.text: Five minutes later, police raid the lobby and arrest the loan sharks—while Valerie faces her own court summons.
Thank you... I know I don’t deserve your help after Suite 904.
Valerie signs a complete written confession detailing Caleb’s entire Suite 904 scheme before officers arrive.
I told Dad everything. Caleb was the one who bought the sleeping capsules.
With Valerie’s signed statement, Caleb’s last defense evaporates.
Wait—security just caught two silhouettes sneaking into your studio warehouse after dark. Caleb’s trying to burn your autumn stock!

nodes.headline: Fire In The Atelier
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Warehouse Shadows — Caleb can’t stand watching your autumn collection succeed without him.

nodes.text: 9:40 PM · Caleb can’t stand watching your autumn collection succeed without him. He hired two vandals to ruin 2,000 silk gowns.
Warehouse CCTV caught two figures cutting the side fence at 9:38 PM! Our patrol is 3 minutes out!
Activate the smart sprinklers and lock the loading bay shutters remotely!
Torch the silk racks and get out in 60 seconds—don’t leave a lighter behind!

nodes.transcript: [sirens wailing in background] "Sprinklers drenched them before a single match lit! Police just cuffed both men at the bay door!"

nodes.caption: Atelier Warehouse CCTV · 21:38 — two hired silhouettes caught breaching the loading bay before sprinklers triggered.

nodes.text: [rain drumming on metal] "I’m outside Dock B—Caleb just pried the side latch open with a crowbar and a canister. Police are two minutes out; don’t step inside alone!"
Outside Dock B right now—Caleb just broke the side latch with a canister. Police are 2 mins out, stay back!

nodes.prompt: One of the vandals offers to call Caleb on speakerphone to prove who hired him:

options.label: Let police record the speakerphone call live
options.player_reply_text: Put Caleb on speaker. Let him ask if the silk racks burned.

options.label: Send Caleb a photo of your dry, pristine gowns

nodes.text: Caleb picks up on ring one: "Is her whole autumn line ash yet?"—straight into a detective’s recorder.
Wait—who’s breathing on the line?! Hang up!!
You text Caleb a gleaming photo of the plastic-wrapped silk racks—minutes before cruisers pull up to his house.
How did you know we were coming?! Who tipped you off?!
Not a single yard of silk was lost. By midnight, Caleb Vance is booked on felony arson conspiracy.
Your runway show opens Friday night. Still need an escort for the front row?

nodes.headline: From Ashes To Runway
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Runway Of Gold — Fashion Week Pavilion.

nodes.text: 7:45 PM · Fashion Week Pavilion. Five hundred buyers fill the room. Your father sits beside Nathaniel in the front row, beaming with pride.
Backstage check—still nervous, or ready to own the entire season?
I survived a poisoned engagement and a warehouse ambush. A runway is easy.
Watching the runway livestream from rehab. Your dresses are gorgeous, Madeline.

nodes.transcript: [warm smile in voice] "Milan and Paris buyers just pre-ordered your entire spring line before the finale gown even hit the lights!"

nodes.prompt: The final curtain parts for your designer bow:

options.label: Take your bow & wave to your father first
options.player_reply_text: Thank you everyone—this collection is called "Unbroken."

options.label: Walk down the steps & hand Nathaniel a rose

nodes.text: Thunderous applause shakes the pavilion as flashbulbs light up your triumphant smile.
Look at your dad—he hasn’t stopped smiling all night!
You step off the runway and place a white rose in Nathaniel’s lapel, drawing delighted gasps from the front row.
Careful—the tabloids will finally have a real romance to print.
After the show, your phone buzzes with the court’s final update: Caleb sentenced to 8 years; Valerie placed on strict probation.
One last cup of jasmine tea on the rooftop—brewed by me, zero surprises?

nodes.headline: A Clean Cup
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Jasmine At Midnight — Rooftop terrace glowing above the city.

nodes.text: 10:30 PM · Rooftop terrace glowing above the city. Two steaming porcelain cups rest on the table—this time, filled only with warmth.
I took the first sip from both cups just so you wouldn’t have to swap them.
Smart man. That already puts you light-years ahead of my ex-fiancé.
My appeal was denied. I ruined everything.

nodes.transcript: [soft laughter] "Paris showroom opens in April. Need a business partner—or maybe something more permanent?"

nodes.prompt: Nathaniel clinks his teacup gently against yours:

options.label: Toast to "something more permanent"
options.player_reply_text: Let’s start with dinner in Paris—and see where this lifetime takes us.

options.label: Keep him guessing with a playful smirk

nodes.text: Nathaniel’s smile deepens under the string lights as midnight chimes softly.
Deal. First-class tickets to Paris, booked.
You raise an eyebrow over the porcelain rim, making the stoic investor laugh out loud.
Fair enough—I’ll earn every single yes properly.
The jasmine breeze drifts across the rooftop. One swapped teacup rewrote your entire destiny.
She tried to drug me out of my own life. Instead, I woke up to a better one.

nodes.headline: Sweetest Victory · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: The autumn runway shines in gold and jasmine steam rises at midnight — your sweetest victory tastes like freedom.
